title: Tunisian Chickpea Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry dish originating from Tunisia, made with chickpeas and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: umami
ingredients.notes: soy sauce or tamari for flavor

ingredients.name: stir
ingredients.notes: olive or vegetable oil for frying

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add Tunisian spice blend and stir for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and stir to coat with spice blend.
Add soy sauce and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
